ZViewerMulti-user synchronized video watching, anime tracking, and remote sharing platform

Let a group of people watch anime and movies together from different locations as if they were sitting together. The host controls playback progress, viewers follow in real time.

Quick Start
Features
GitHub
🎬

Watch Together Rooms

Create or join a room. The host controls play, pause, seek, and playback speed, while viewers follow in real time. If the host disconnects, the server takes over broadcasting to keep playback uninterrupted. The host can appoint moderators to help manage the room.

🔗

Multi-source Video Parsing

Supports Bilibili (premium member resolution, short-link parsing), direct MP4 links, WebDAV, FTP, OpenList, Emby/Jellyfin, server files, and more video sources.

💬

Real-time Interaction

Comment panel, viewer request for control, voice chat (server relay) and voice moderation.

🗨️

Danmaku System

Supports Bilibili danmaku, DandanPlay danmaku, custom danmaku tracks, track overlaying, and danmaku doubling effects.

🖥️

Screen Sharing and Streaming

WebRTC-based screen sharing, OBS RTMP streaming with Node Media Server for HTTP-FLV playback.

🎨

Material You Theme

Extracts colors from wallpaper to generate a complete palette, light/dark theme switching, custom background, glassmorphism UI.

🚀

Minimal Deployment

One-command startup from source, single-file exe, Docker image, GitHub Actions auto-build, pure JS implementation with no native modules.
